needs_launcher: This view belongs to a launcher: context.launcher is missing
no_launcher_keys: This extension isn’t allowed to use launcher keys
not_its_gateway: This launcher’s gateway doesn’t belong to this extension
view_unsupported: This hub can’t draw the extension’s view: {err}
state_too_large: The page the extension opens has state over {max} bytes
push_not_its_ui: The page {ui} the extension opens isn’t one of its views
push_not_page: {ui}, which the extension opens, isn’t a full page (only extension_page or nav_page can be opened)
open_not_source: The persona: link the extension opens isn’t this item’s source (only an inbox item’s view can open persona://inbox/<item>/source)
open_not_https: The extension can only open https links
no_item: This item isn’t in the inbox
not_its_item: This item didn’t come from this extension’s connector
not_served: This extension doesn’t handle this connector now
